nfts.yield_unit: t/ha at15% moisture; source dt/ha×0.1, verified in each native Swedish record.
nfts.replication_unit: Trial site-year for holdout; treatment/cultivar contrasts within one trial are not independent environments.

ahdb.disease_scope: Top four leaves under published RL assessment protocol; actual assessment dates and leaf-specific observations absent from these summaries.
ahdb.protected_definition: Fungicide-treated yield trial using full RL fungicide and PGR programme; untreated trial receives PGR but no fungicides.
ahdb.yield_role: Matched site/cultivar fungicide response, not an identified STB-only disease-free yield counterfactual.
